description: Pyregence is a web portal for displaying near-term wildfire spread and impact forecasts for California. Its README identifies ELMFIRE and Pyretechnics as contributing fire-behaviour models and describes a Clojure, JavaScript and PostgreSQL development environment. Users select a place and forecast period through the portal; outputs are fire spread and impact maps from continuously updated weather inputs. Geographic coverage in the documented service is California, with forecast resolution set by its underlying models and weather feed. GitHub metadata states EPL-2.0 licensing for the portal code; model and map licences remain separate. A limitation is that forecast maps are scenario outputs and should not replace official evacuation instructions, and G7 did not check live forecast skill. The portal can inform wildfire exposure scenarios for power, road and emergency-service simulations. The related QGIS catalogue platform can analyse exported layers. No forecast raster or code archive was downloaded.
name: Pyregence California fire forecast portal
notes: G7 G7-2019. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
